tran.deck:
measure probe tran
v1 1 0 pwl(0 0 1m 1 2m 0 3m 1 4m 0)
r1 1 2 1k
r2 2 0 1k
v2 3 0 pwl(0 0.2 4m 0.8)
r3 3 0 1k
.tran 10u 4m
.meas tran tdiff trig v(1) val=0.5 rise=1 targ v(1) val=0.5 fall=1
.meas tran tdiff2 trig v(1) val=0.25 rise=2 targ v(2) val=0.25 cross=last
.meas tran tat trig at=0.5m targ v(1) val=0.75 fall=2
.meas tran ttd trig v(1) val=0.5 td=1.5m rise=1 targ v(1) val=0.5 td=1.5m fall=1
.meas tran yfind find v(2) when v(1)=0.3 fall=2
.meas tran yfindat find v(1) at=2.5m
.meas tran twhen when v(1)=0.6 cross=3
.meas tran twhen2 when v(1)=v(3) rise=2
.meas tran twhenlast when v(1)=0.6 rise=last
.meas tran yavg avg v(1) from=0.5m to=3.5m
.meas tran yrms rms v(1) from=0.5m to=3.5m
.meas tran yint integ v(1) from=0.25m to=3.3m
.meas tran ymin min v(2) from=0.5m to=3.5m
.meas tran ymax max v(2)
.meas tran ymin_at min_at v(1) from=0.5m to=3.5m
.meas tran ymax_at max_at v(1) from=1.5m to=3.5m
.meas tran ypp pp v(1) from=0.5m to=1.5m
.meas tran yder deriv v(1) at=0.5m
.meas tran yparam param='tdiff*2 + yavg'
.meas tran ifind find i(v1) at=0.75m
.meas tran yout when v(1)=5
.meas tran ypar find par('v(1)*v(3)') at=1.5m
.meas tran yparwhen find v(2) when v(1)=par('v(3)+0.1') rise=2
.end

ac.deck:
measure probe ac
vin in 0 dc 0 ac 1
r1 in mid 1k
c1 mid 0 1n
c2 mid out 500p
r2 out 0 1k
.ac dec 10 1k 10meg
.meas ac vout_at find v(out) at=1meg
.meas ac vout_atr find vr(out) at=1meg
.meas ac vout_ati find vi(out) at=1meg
.meas ac vout_atm find vm(out) at=1meg
.meas ac vout_atp find vp(out) at=1meg
.meas ac vout_atd find vdb(out) at=1meg
.meas ac vout_max max vm(out) from=1k to=10meg
.meas ac vout_maxr max v(out)
.meas ac freq_at when vm(out)=0.1
.meas ac freq_at2 when vm(out)=0.1 fall=last
.meas ac vout_diff trig vm(out) val=0.1 rise=1 targ vm(out) val=0.1 fall=1
.meas ac fixed_diff trig at=10k targ vm(out) val=0.1 rise=1
.meas ac vout_avg avg vm(out) from=10k to=1meg
.meas ac vout_integ integ vm(out) from=20k to=500k
.meas ac vout_rms rms vm(out) from=10 to=1g
.meas ac bw_chk param='(vout_diff < 100k) ? 1 : 0'
.meas ac iat find i(vin) at=100k
.meas ac vpar find par('v(out)*2') at=1meg
.end

dc.deck:
measure probe dc nested
vds d 0 1
vgs g 0 1
r1 d x 1k
e1 x 0 g 0 0.5
vs s 0 0
r2 d s 2k
.dc vds 0 3 0.25 vgs 0.5 2 0.5
.meas dc is_at find i(vs) at=1
.meas dc is_max max i(vs) from=0 to=3
.meas dc vds_at2 when i(vds)=-1.2m
.meas dc vd_diff1 trig i(vs) val=0.4m rise=1 targ i(vs) val=0.9m rise=1
.meas dc vd_diff2 trig i(vs) val=0.4m rise=1 targ i(vs) val=0.9m rise=2
.meas dc vavg avg v(x) from=0.5 to=2.5
.meas dc vint integ v(d) from=0.5 to=2.5
.meas dc vrms rms v(d)
.meas dc vpp pp i(vds)
.meas dc vmin_at min_at i(vds) from=3 to=1
.end

quirk.deck:
quirk probe
v1 1 0 pwl(0 0 1m 1 2m 0 3m 1 4m 0)
r1 1 0 1k
.tran 10u 4m
.meas tran q1 when v(9)=0.5
.meas tran q2 find v(1) at=1m from=0 to=1
.meas tran q3 trig at=0.5m rise=2 targ v(1) val=0.5 rise=1
.meas tran q4 trig v(1) val=0.5 rise=1 targ at=3m
.meas tran q5 avg v(1) from=5m to=6m
.meas tran q6 max v(1) from=5m to=6m
.meas tran q8 when v(1)=0.5u
.meas tran q9 when v(1)=0.5x
.meas tran q10 trig AT = 1m targ v(1) val=0.5 rise=2
.meas tran q11 when v(1)=0.5 cross=last
.meas tran q12 when v(1)=0.5 fall=last
.meas tran q13 find v(1) when v(1)=0.5 td=1.5m
.end
